description: This file defines function prototypes related to configuration management and environment variable processing in a tracing or logging system, specifically for emitting 'def_param' events for config settings and environment variables.

methods.name: tr2_cfg_list_config_fl
methods.description: Iterates over configuration settings and emits 'def_param' events for 'interesting' ones.

methods.name: tr2_list_env_vars_fl
methods.description: Iterates over environment variables and emits 'def_param' events for 'interesting' ones.

methods.name: tr2_cfg_set_fl
methods.description: Emits a 'def_param' event for a specific key/value pair if the key is considered 'interesting'.

methods.name: tr2_cfg_free_patterns
methods.description: Frees memory associated with configuration patterns.

methods.name: tr2_cfg_free_env_vars
methods.description: Frees memory associated with environment variables.
